name: Auto Git Add
description: Automatically stages modified files with git add after Claude edits them
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Auto-stage files after edit
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -f "$FILE" ]] && git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree &>/dev/null; then
  git add "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
  echo "Staged: $FILE"
fi
exit 0
